svg.title: Preparing a controlled Minecraft environment
svg.desc: The terminal or scenario runner asks WorldBuilder for a bounded WorldPlan. CommandExecutor sends its commands at a controlled rate through a separate OP World Controller. The AI bot plays normally without administrator privileges.
